description: This file contains core utility functions for managing diagnostics options, file transfer, firmware upgrade, and network interface configurations in a device management context. It includes functions for file transfer via curl, checksum validation, firmware upgrade procedures, and network interface updates, with conditional compilation for different SSL libraries.

classes.name: sysupgrade_ev_data
classes.description: Data structure for sysupgrade event data, containing bank ID and status.

methods.name: get_diagnostics_option
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnostics option value for a given section and option name.

methods.name: get_diagnostics_option_fallback_def
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnostics option value or returns a default if not set.

methods.name: set_diagnostics_option
methods.description: Sets a diagnostics option value for a given section and option.

methods.name: reset_diagnostic_state
methods.description: Resets the diagnostic state to 'None' if not already requested.

methods.name: get_diagnostics_interface_option
methods.description: Gets the interface option value, resolving device IP interface references.

methods.name: validate_file_system_size
methods.description: Checks if the file size is within available filesystem space.

methods.name: validate_hash_value
methods.description: Validates a file's hash value against a checksum using specified algorithm.

methods.name: validate_checksum_value
methods.description: Validates a file's checksum based on the specified algorithm.

methods.name: bbf_config_backup
methods.description: Backs up configuration and uploads it to a specified URL.

methods.name: bbf_upload_log
methods.description: Uploads a log file to a specified URL.

methods.name: bbf_config_restore
methods.description: Downloads and restores configuration from a URL, validating checksum.

methods.name: dmubus_receive_sysupgrade
methods.description: Handles sysupgrade events received via ubus.

methods.name: bbf_fw_image_download
methods.description: Downloads firmware image, validates, applies, and optionally reboots.

methods.name: ppp___update_sections
methods.description: Copies PPP configuration options from one section to another.

methods.name: ppp___reset_options
methods.description: Resets PPP options to defaults.

methods.name: firewall__create_zone_section
methods.description: Creates a firewall zone section with default options.

methods.name: ip___is_ip_interface_instance_exists
methods.description: Checks if an IP interface instance exists for a device.

methods.name: ip___update_child_interfaces
methods.description: Updates child interface options for a device.

methods.name: ip___Update_IP_Interface_Layer
methods.description: Updates IP interface layer options based on configuration.

methods.name: ppp___Update_PPP_Interface_Layer
methods.description: Updates PPP interface layer options based on configuration.

methods.name: ppp___Update_PPP_Interface_Top_Layers
methods.description: Updates top layers of PPP interfaces.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_MAC_VLAN_Layer
methods.description: Updates MAC VLAN layer options for Ethernet devices.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_MAC_VLAN_Top_Layers
methods.description: Updates top layers of MAC VLAN configurations.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_VLAN_Termination_Layer
methods.description: Updates VLAN termination layer options.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_VLAN_Termination_Top_Layers
methods.description: Updates top layers of VLAN termination configurations.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_Link_Layer
methods.description: Updates link layer options for Ethernet devices.

methods.name: ethernet___Update_Link_Top_Layers
methods.description: Updates top layers of Ethernet link configurations.

methods.name: bridging___get_priority_list
methods.description: Retrieves priority list from a bridging device section.

methods.name: bridging___set_priority_list
methods.description: Sets priority list in a bridging device section.

methods.name: ethernet___get_ethernet_interface_section
methods.description: Retrieves Ethernet interface section by device name.

methods.name: ethernet___get_ethernet_interface_name
methods.description: Gets Ethernet interface name, handling dual tags and device lookup.
